newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Uneximbank to raise capital to 5 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russian Uneximbank to raise capital to 5 trln rbls.

text.p: Uneximbank, one of Russia's biggest banks, is to raise authorised but unissued capital to five trillion roubles from 1.002 trillion roubles, a bank statement said on Thursday.
The increase, approved by shareholders on Wednesday, will result in capital consisting of one million ordinary shares with a face value of five million roubles, it said.
A bank spokesman said the board of directors had re-elected Vladimir Potanin as president.
Potanin was Uneximbank president from 1993 to August 1996, when he was appointed First Deputy Prime Minister. He quit the government position in March and returned to Uneximbank.
NOTE - Fugures in billion roubles to Russian accounting system, audited by Deloitte & Touche. Full Russian name Oneksimbank.

Uneximbank's major shareholders are oil group NK Sidanko, Nafta-Moskva and AO Purneftegaz oil companies, LOMO optic factory, Rosvooruzheniye weapons exporter, AO Yuganskneftegaz, Novokuznetsk Aluminum Factory, AO Fosforit chemicals factory, Moscow Aviation Factory.
